films.title: The Round Up
films.overview: A faithful retelling of the 1942 "Vel' d'Hiv Roundup" and the events surrounding it.

films.title: My Summer in Provence
films.overview: In the wake of their parent's separation, three siblings spend the summer in the south of France with their estranged Grandfather. In less than 24 hours, a clash of generations has occurred between the teenagers and the old man. During this turbulent summer, both generations will be transformed by one another.
